name: hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns
description: Returns only completed (IsDone=1, IsCancelled=0) DownDown charges for a run, with each charge's list of named hashers. Visible to any kennel member (non-removed HasherKennelMap row). Returns two result rowsets on success. Intended for the run detail history view — non-admin users see only what was delivered. Read-only SP — no success envelope. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to fetch completed DownDowns for. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope returned on auth, validation, or membership check failure: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with CompletedDownDowns rowset.

rowsets.name: CompletedDownDowns
rowsets.description: One row per completed DownDown (IsDone=1, IsCancelled=0) for the event, ordered by CreatedAt ASC. Empty result set when no completed charges exist. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.id — primary key of the charge.

columns.name: isDone
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsDone — BIT column; always 1/true in this result set (filter predicate enforces it). Serialised as JSON boolean by the .NET shim.

columns.name: isCancelled
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled — BIT column; always 0/false in this result set (filter predicate enforces it). Serialised as JSON boolean.

columns.name: songChoice
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongChoice — suggested song name, or NULL if not set.

columns.name: songId
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.SongId cast to lowercase NVARCHAR(40) via LOWER(CAST(...)). NULL if not set.

columns.name: chargePhotoUrl
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.ChargePhotoUrl — blob URL of an attached charge photo, or NULL.

columns.name: createdByDisplayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charge creator.

columns.name: createdByPhoto
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Photo for the charge creator — profile photo URL.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: HC.DownDowns.CreatedAt — UTC datetime when the charge was created.

rowsets.name: CompletedDownDownHashers
rowsets.description: One row per charged hasher for the completed DownDowns returned in rowset 0. The client groups by downDownId to associate hashers with their charge. Empty when no completed DownDowns exist.

columns.name: downDownId
columns.description: HC.DownDownHashers.DownDownId — FK linking back to rowset 0.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) for the charged hasher.

rowsets.description: Returned at index 1 alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on auth, validation, or membership errors. Mutually exclusive with CompletedDownDownHashers rowset.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, or membership errors.

codeSmells.issue: IsDone and IsCancelled columns are BIT, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsDone and IsCancelled are BIT NOT NULL. The .NET shim serialises BIT as JSON boolean. Dart callers must parse these as boolean, not int. Both will always be constant values in this result set (isDone=true, isCancelled=false), but the Dart model still needs correct deserialization.

codeSmells.issue: spNumber 58 is shared with hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns and hcapp_updateDownDown
codeSmells.detail: Both hcapp_updateDownDown and hcapp_getCompletedDownDowns pass @spNumber = 58 to ValidateAppAuth. SP numbers should be unique identifiers within the auth system. If the auth system uses spNumber for anything other than logging, this collision could cause unexpected behaviour.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON but not SET XACT_ABORT ON. Since this is a read-only SP this is harmless, but it is inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard.
